confidence_notes: Food and drink: informed by five web searches, using search-result summaries only (no pages opened). Numbeo's Sarande data (Oct 2026) gave an inexpensive meal of about 800 Lek, a mid-range meal for two of about 4,500 Lek, a cappuccino of about 178 Lek and a domestic beer of about 130 Lek. I cross-checked these against other cost-of-living sites. Saranda samples are small and sources disagree by 30-50%. Lek was converted at roughly 83 Lek/USD (approximate, not verified). Beer is set above Numbeo to reflect July tourist-venue pricing. No aggregated Saranda cocktail or wine price was found, so cocktail (about 3x beer) and wine glass (about 1.5x beer) rest on one nightlife blog's ranges plus typical beer ratios. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season from general knowledge. No accommodation prices were searched or inspected, and peak-season variance is large.
comparable_city_reasoning: Albanian Riviera beach resort: priced above Tirana and inland Albania but below Corfu and Greek-island resorts. Accommodation is reasoned from similar Ionian/Adriatic summer resort towns such as Vlora, Ksamil and Himara in July peak season.
